translation: Let me now explain the rules of chess.
Let's explain how to play "chess mode.”

In this mode, your objective is to solve the
chess puzzles presented by…
…each of the characters.

Presenting the puzzles will be the five
characters—Itsuki Koizumi, Mikuru Asahina…

…Tsuruya, Yuki Nagato, and Haruhi Suzumiya.
Itsuki Koizumi and Mikuru Asahina are…

…selectable by default, but in order to unlock
the other three's puzzles…

…you must first solve a certain amount of
puzzles.

Solving Mikuru Asahina's problems will unlock
Tsuruya's—solving Tsuruya's puzzles…

…will unlock Yuki Nagato's—solving Yuki
Nagato's puzzles will unlock…
…Haruhi Suzumiya's.

If you solve every character's puzzles, you
will unlock exclusive event artwork…
…so please give it your best.
There are two main types of chess puzzles.

In one, your objective is to checkmate the
black king in the prescribed number of moves.

Carefully observe the state of the board
and move the pieces such that you…

…checkmate in the set number of moves.
There are even some puzzles with a time limit.

In the other, your objective is to place the
black king…
…such that it is in checkmate.

Carefully observe the state of the board,
and touch the square that you think will work.

The black king will be placed in that square,
and if that causes a checkmate…

…it will be considered correct, otherwise it will
be considered incorrect.
Some of these puzzles also have a time limit.

Let's have a go at solving some chess
puzzles for real.

I've prepared a simple puzzle, so consider
everything you've been told…
…and have a casual go at it.
Let's begin.
Checkmate your opponent in one move.
That's correct. As expected of you.

Unfortunately, that's incorrect.
Go ahead and give it another go.

If you forget the rules of chess, you can
check them again by…
…playing the first puzzle once again.
